from scrapy.http import Request
from scrapy.utils.url import safe_url_string, escape_ajax
import unittest
import six

class TestRequest(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_set_url(self):
        r = Request('http://www.example.com/')
        self.assertEqual(r._url, 'http://www.example.com/')

        r = Request('http://www.example.com/', meta={'dont_merge': True})
        self.assertEqual(r._url, 'http://www.example.com/')

        r = Request('http://www.example.com/', encoding='latin-1')
        self.assertEqual(r._url, 'http://www.example.com/')

        r = Request('http://www.example.com/', encoding='iso-8859-1')
        self.assertEqual(r._url, 'http://www.example.com/')

        r = Request('http://www.example.com/', dont_filter=True)
        self.assertEqual(r._url, 'http://www.example.com/')

        r = Request('http://www.example.com/', priority=1.2)
        self.assertEqual(r._url, 'http://www.example.com/')

        r = Request('http://www.example.com/', headers={'foo': 'bar'})
        self.assertEqual(r._url, 'http://www.example.com/')

        r = Request('http://www.example.com/', meta={'foo': 'bar'})
        self.assertEqual(r._url, 'http://www.example.com/')

        r = Request('http://www.example.com/', method='GET')
        self.assertEqual(r._url, 'http://www.example.com/')

        r = Request('http://www.example.com/', body=b'hello')
        self.assertEqual(r._url, 'http://www.example.com/')

        r = Request('http://www.example.com/', callback=lambda x: None)
        self.assertEqual(r._url, 'http://www.example.com/')

        r = Request('http://www.example.com/', dont_filter=False)
        self.assertEqual(r._url, 'http://www.example.com/')

        r = Request('http://www.example.com/', cookies={'foo': 'bar'})
        self.assertEqual(r._url, 'http://www.example.com/')
